content.title: Contact-Bound Energy Combat | Pressure, Grounded Flashes, Ordered Clearance
content.summary: A depot electrician disables four training drones through contact-bound arcs. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One pressured arena and all opponents are established. + Energy appears on a bounded body part before first contact. + Every effect is attached to visible physical contact. + Opponents exit the active lane in readable order. + Effects cease and one stable terminal state remains.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult depot electrician on one marked floor lane while four adult training drones close in. Use one palm redirect and one low kick; each visible contact creates a short blue arc and moves one drone out of the lane. Let the arcs stop completely and hold the same electrician alone beside four disabled drones.
